workflow.transparencyStrategy: flat chroma-key generation followed by the installed ImageGen removal helper
workflow.normalization: trim transparent bounds, proportionally contain inside a 720x720 transparent area, then add 24px transparent padding on every side for an exact 768x768 RGBA texture
workflow.notes: No CLI image model or model-native transparency was used. The world renderer draws these effect-only sprites over the four doors authored into memory-plaza-v1.png; the v2 freestanding architectural portal assets remain available for menu thumbnails but are no longer used in the world.

requests.doorFacing: north wall, facing south into plaza
requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated game VFX sprite for the NORTH expedition doorway
Primary request: create only a crimson-red and warm ivory magical portal effect that fits inside the existing tall gothic doorway in the reference plaza
Input images: Image 1 is a visual problem reference showing the unwanted freestanding portal structure; Image 2 is the full plaza map geometry reference. Use them only for scale, camera angle, and doorway silhouette. Do not edit or reproduce either scene.
Subject: a thin vertical energy veil, concentric broken runes, sparks, and a bright but controlled core; absolutely no physical door, arch, masonry, pillars, frame, stairs, pedestal, floor, sign, or architecture
Style/medium: premium dark fantasy ARPG spell VFX, painterly-realistic, crisp game sprite
Composition/framing: centered effect, near-frontal screen-space silhouette for the north wall doorway, tall arched oval occupying about 58% width and 78% height, generous empty padding
Lighting/mood: crimson glow with pale-gold highlights, ominous and legible without overexposure
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal
Constraints: the background is one uniform #00ff00 with no shadow, gradient, texture, reflection, floor plane, or lighting variation; do not use #00ff00 in the effect; isolated VFX only; no text; no watermark
Avoid: any freestanding portal object, doorway frame, stone, metal, building, platform, base, ground shadow, logo
